fields.exe: Bannerlator 3.0.1, I cannot launch any build of the Proton11-arm64 container.
fields.when: Fails at the publisher/loading logo在发行商/加载标志处失败
fields.repro:
This is a rather strange issue. After updating Bannerlator 3.0.0 or 3.0.1, I cannot launch any build of the Proton11-arm64 container.
But，Bannerlator 2.9.6 to 2.9.9, selecting Bannerlator_gamenative_wrapper allows access to the Proton11-B5-arm64 container. Bannerlator 3.0.0 pre1 and Bannerlator 3.0.0 pre2 support launching all Proton11-arm64 container builds without issues.
